records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] testMissingOptionOnSave now asserts assertNoMessage("Missing required argument") after enabling the feature, but no positive assertion replaced it, so the 'save metadata succeeds with feature enabled and required option' behavior is verified only implicitly via the later testCompatible test; the case where the feature is enabled but the option is missing remains green regardless of whether validation fires. A regression that stops enforcing the required --output option on the metadata subcommand (e.g. after the new feature gate early-returns or validation is reordered) keeps this test green, so CI passes while the CLI accepts an invalid invocation. Whoever refactors validateConfig()/run() ordering gets no signal.
records.rationale: The finding hinges on the assumption that the metadata subcommand has a *required* `--output` option and that this test should fail when it is omitted.
